name: freeze-mark
title: Freeze Mark
summary: On your word the frame freezes, the room drops to black and white while you keep your colour, and marker scribbles draw themselves on: a loose circle round your face, a handwritten caption and an arrow pointing at you.
keyMoment: the picture freezes and goes black and white on the word, and the marker circle starts drawing round your face on the same frame

variables.label: The handwritten caption that points at you
Turn the room black and white on the freeze (you keep your colour)
